description: He wears a textured burgundy knee-length outer tunic with gold plant-scroll embroidery along its front and hem over a cream long-sleeved linen-like undertunic. The cream neckline is laced, and its cuffs have narrow brown woven borders. A deep brown-plum cloak covers the shoulders, has short open sleeves, gold scroll borders and two round gold shoulder clasps linked by a chain. A brown decorated belt has a round gold buckle, small studs and a hanging medallion-studded end. Dark fitted trousers and brown calf-high leather boots with low heels complete the outfit. No headgear or weapon appears.
